title: Training
content: Last night and for the past week or so I have been going to some sort of space camp. I can’t otherwise explain what it is. I’m always wearing a NASA like space suit and put into a metal chamber/box type thing. Then a machine is turned on that literally evaporates you into molecules and transports you elsewhere. Think of Mike TV from Charlie and the Chocolate Factory. I was disassembled into particles and then put back together again but it had to be done inside this air tight metal chamber thing or else it wouldn’t work. I remember maybe three other people with me who were also dressed like me trying to comfort me because I was terrified. I think I kept telling them I didn’t want to do this. But I remember feeling like I had no choice. If you have ever seen that movie Contact with Jodi Foster it felt a lot like when she was put inside the wormhole machine and has this otherworldly experience and then pops out back into our reality like she was only gone for a second. That’s basically what it felt like an intense wormhole through space. Then I was right back in the metal chamber room. After this I am also constantly on space readiness machines testing and strengthening my abilities to withstand zero gravity and space flight simulation. I also do water training. After I do this “training” I am allowed free time in the world so I visit the food court, zoo, concert, movie theater, arcade, grocery store, etc. anyone else have this experience?
